notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
BRUTALISTIKA demo is now available on Steam!

BRUTALISTIKA is an immersive and contemplative experience.

In this walking simulator, explore mysterious and intriguing liminal spaces with neo-brutalist architecture, filled with peaceful pools and interactive works that invite you to interpret your emotions at your own pace.

We can't wait to hear your feedback on this intriguing universe where not everything is revealed...
You'll have to wait for the final version to solve and try to understand all its mysteries :-)

👉 Test the demo and add it to your wishlist so you don't miss any upcoming announcements!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527970/BRUTALISTIKA_Demo

Thank you for your support and feedback which will allow us to improve the final version.
🖤💛❤️
